_doc: Deterministic tool router. An agent may use a tool only if it appears in that tool's 'agents' list and 'enabled_if' holds. Otherwise use 'fallback'. enabled_if: 'always' | 'env:VAR' | 'mcp:name' | 'cli:bin' | 'user:enable'.

tools.notes: Google Stitch is a free Google Labs beta. Manual loop today: the agent writes the prompt (stitch-design-taste skill), the user pastes the result back. Google also documents an official Stitch MCP server (stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp); the MCP server `stitch` (https://stitch.googleapis.com/mcp, X-Goog-Api-Key header) was added at user scope on 2026-09-30 and lists 15 tools. design-director may use everything except delete_project, works only in projects it created (one per fork: uibuilder-<slug>-direction-<A|B|C>, so forks never see each other's screens; uibuilder-<slug>-critic for the critic), and treats output as pre-G2 concept material, never production UI. The key lives in the owner's ~/.claude.json, never in this repo. Reported free limits conflict between sources (400 daily credits vs 550 generations a month), so treat them as unverified.
Project procedure: .claude/skills/security-review/SKILL.md. Apply before G3 and retain source/runtime evidence in SECURITY_REPORT.md.

tools.cost: prepaid credits at $0.01 each (official docs 2026-09-30); no free API credits confirmed
tools.notes: Runway Dev API is a model router on one key: wan3, seedance2 / seedance2_fast / seedance2_mini, veo3.1 / veo3.1_fast, hailuo3, gen4_turbo, plus image models (muse_image, gen4_image_turbo, seedream5_lite, gemini_image3_pro). Prices in docs/MEDIA_PROVIDERS.md. App credits on app.runwayml.com are separate from API credits. Use `node scripts/media-generate.mjs --provider runway ...` (dry run by default; `--run --approve-credits N` to spend; over 100 credits needs the owner). Live-verified 2026-09-30: veo3.1_fast, 4s, first and last frame, 40 credits, output matched both frames. First/last frames work on seedance2, seedance2_fast, seedance2_mini, veo3.1 and veo3.1_fast only. Env var RUNWAYML_API_SECRET confirmed. The scroll-world skill still has no Runway backend, so chains are assembled clip by clip with this script.
